title: How equals and hashCode work in collections
answer: Hash-based collections use hashCode() to narrow the search to a bucket and equals() to confirm whether candidate keys are logically the same. Think of hashCode() as candidate-location selection and equals() as final logical-identity confirmation, not as competing equality mechanisms.
